Select assay_chembl_id from assays, target_type and tax_id from target_dictionary, canonical_smiles from compound_structures, molecule_chembl_id from molecule_dictionary, standard_type and pchembl_value from activities. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795194', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
